item.title: First-ever borderless tax: IMO approves a global carbon tax on shipping | The Witty Herald
item.description: IMO approves historic global carbon tax on shipping to cut emissions, but climate-vulnerable nations warn it is too weak to protect them from rising seas.

item.title: 26 tourists killed in Kashmir attack, setting Indo-Pak diplomatic crisis in motion | The Witty Herald
item.description: After 26 tourists were killed in a Kashmir shooting, India and Pakistan exchanged accusations and restrictions, escalating fears of further regional instability.

item.title: The world says goodbye to the people’s Pope | Pope Francis dies at 88 | The Witty Herald
item.description: Pope Francis, shepherd of the margins, dies at 88. A papacy of firsts, marked by humility, mercy, interfaith unity, bold reform, and a heart that beat for the forgotten and unseen.

item.description: Religious hardliners in Bangladesh misuse faith to block long-overdue women’s rights reforms, fueling misogyny and resisting progress under the guise of devotion.
